findings: l.1146–1148: « les W_i sont des facettes coniques » is an abuse of language. Read literally it is false for every W_i that is not a point, so this is not a degenerate case: a facette (Déf. 4, an α-class) is relatively open, and W_i is a facette of the closed sum iff W_i equals its interior relative to l_i (isFacetteK_iff_relInterior_eq). A strict closed W_i with nonempty interior in l_i is relatively open only when it is a point. That general step (l_i connected when dim L_i ≥ 2; a strict part of S(0) is a point) is argued here, not formalized; the Lean witness is the iff above plus a concrete counterexample. Counterexample: the closed triangle of S(2) as the closed sum of the closed edge [s(e₀), s(e₁)] ⊆ l₀ = s(⟨e₀,e₁⟩ − O) and the vertex s(e₂): the closed edge is not a facette, and the open edge is a conical facette whose closure is the closed edge (exemple_arete_fermee). The intended form (the relative interior of W_i is a conical facette with closure W_i and support l_i) is proved for every p and every W_i.

l.1145–1146: the parenthetical « (W_i convexe fermé d'intérieur non vide pour la topologie de L_i) » omits « de noyau vide », which the paper's own characterization of corps convexes includes (l.795: « Les corps convexes ne sont autres que les convexes fermés d'intérieur non vide, et de noyau vide »). Read alone it does not suffice: W = S(0) = l (L = E, p = 1) is convex, closed, of nonempty interior, no w is a sum of it in the sense of § 2 Déf. 5 (F(W) = E − O is not convex), and s(F(W) ∪ {O} − O) = S(0) is not a convex body (exemple_sans_stricte). With « corps convexe » (strict) the Remark holds.
questions: « S(n) soit la somme » of p linear subvarieties: read E = ⊕ L_i (DirectSum.IsInternal). § 2 Déf. 5 read literally for two linear subvarieties is degenerate (estSomme2_univ_linearSubvariety_iff, FacetteConique); Déf. 6's bracket gives IsCompl for p = 2, which is this reading at p = 2.

« les W_i sont des facettes coniques »: read « the interior of W_i for the topology of l_i is a conical facette of the closed sum, whose closure is W_i and whose support is l_i ». The alternative literal reading holds only when W_i is relatively open (isFacetteK_iff_relInterior_eq), e.g. a point.

« la somme des W_i » of closed W_i: read as § 2 Déf. 5 (EstSommeS: F(w) = Σ F(W_i), every summand nonzero); the closure is then s(Σ(F(W_i) ∪ {O}) − O) (reading (a) of the dispatch, proved, not assumed).
labels.instance: For every surjective f : Fin (n+1) → I the coordinate blocks L_j = {v | v_c = 0 if f c ≠ j} and the block simplices W_j = s({v ∈ L_j | v ≥ 0} − O) satisfy every hypothesis (isInternal_blockL, isCorpsConvexeDans_blockW), the sum exists, and the closure of every sum is TriangleInstance.simplexS n (closure_somme_blockW). f = id: W_j = {vertex j} (blockW_id), the simplex as closed sum of its n+1 vertices (simplexS_closure_somme_vertices). f = ![0,0,1,1]: the S(3) quarter-arc example, closure simplexS 3, the open arcs conical facettes (exemple_arcs_S3). f = ![0,0,1]: the S(2) closed-edge example (exemple_arete_fermee).

kb_proposals: For « S(n) somme de p sous-variétés Lᵢ » use DirectSum.IsInternal L with the endomorphisms proj hL i := (L i).subtype ∘ₗ component i ∘ₗ (LinearEquiv.ofBijective (coeLinearMap L) hL).symm (Chapter3/SommeFacettesConiques): sum_proj, proj_sum and mem_iff_proj reduce every cone computation on ⊕ Lᵢ to coordinates, and closedness of {v | ∀ i, pᵢ v ∈ Kᵢ} is free (continuous_of_finiteDimensional).

Interior « pour la topologie de l » (subspace topology on linearSubvariety L ⊆ S(n)): mem_relInterior_iff turns it into ∃ U open in S(n), x ∈ U, U ∩ l ⊆ W; the algebraic core (IsCore: ∀ v ∈ L, ∃ t > 0, B + t v ∈ K) is what the facette computations need, and a core point is back in the topological relative interior via the open map z ↦ λC + μz and isOpenMap_s on ofCone.

A facette (Déf. 4) is relatively open: a closed convex body Wᵢ of a summand is a facette of a closed sum only when Wᵢ is its own relative interior (isFacetteK_iff_relInterior_eq); read « Wᵢ facette » as « relint Wᵢ facette of closure Wᵢ ».

Coordinate-block instances: SommeFacettesInstance.blockL/blockW for a surjective f : Fin (n+1) → I give IsInternal, the hypotheses of the Remark, and closed sum = TriangleInstance.simplexS n in one line each.
